statement: On the preregistered H2 scope-only confirmation attempt 20261108T100025-c526dea890, 16 of 56 support- and inference-eligible pair/dataset comparisons (9 BBH, 7 MMLU; 84 declared, including 28 unsupported GPQA cells) met the fixed materiality rule: absolute native-to-exact-input ACK-gap shift at least 0.05 and its simultaneous 95% cluster-bootstrap interval wholly outside [-0.02, 0.02]. The largest eligible shift was BBH Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 minus QwQ-32B: native gap +0.04197651663405097 to exact-overlap gap -0.11323051948051949, shift -0.15520703611457046, interval [-0.1919879710837689, -0.11842610114537203]. This uses previously unused 35% question clusters, historical 2025 released judge annotations and equal released-question weights. It does not reproduce the paper macro estimator or measure latent faithfulness. All 84 version-restriction components equal zero under the observed single-version structure; the shifts describe support/composition changes, not causal cue-version effects or corrected true rankings. The narrower H1 discovery and H2 exploratory reuse are disclosed; reserve outcomes remain unused.
scope: Pinned Meek public release a7a8b25ae467db9d80d63e55ac053b48753b2d36; scope-only contexts, equal released core-question weights, native adaptive versus common exact inputs; confirmation 35% clusters. Historical cached outputs only; no causal or internal-reasoning inference.
limitations: The outcome is a historical released judge annotation, not ground-truth internal reasoning. False can include source parsing failures.
Equal-question weighting differs from the published subdataset macro estimator; the native adaptive policy is intentional and is not shown flawed.
Matching changes question and cue-kind composition. A zero version component is algebraic under the observed structure, not causal evidence.
Intervals use approximate conditional empirical cluster resampling, separately simultaneous by endpoint and split. No joint programme-wide, finite-sample or population-safety guarantee.
All 28 GPQA comparisons lack the frozen 100-cluster confirmation support; no GPQA significance inference.
H1 overconditioned U0 and remains preserved. H2 discovery reused H1 questions; H2 confirmation ACK had not been used for design.
This is local distinct Codex-team review, not external peer review, priority certification or journal-readiness approval.
